about: Things that can be picked up. color tints the placeholder shown on the ground (a small glowing gem drawn by code); size is its width in metres. When a modelled file exists, put its id from apps/citywalk/public/assets.json in model and the model is shown instead, scaled to size; the placeholder is only used while model is null or the file fails to load. Item ids are kept in saves, so never rename one: the name players see is in the game's Thai text. kind: material for now. pickup: life = seconds on the ground; popTime = seconds the drop flies out before it can be picked up; magnetRange/collectRange/magnetSpeed = metres, metres, metres per second; scatter = how far a drop lands from where the monster fell.
